fields.label: Catalog source
fields.description: Where distributor catalogs (products, stock, prices, search, ship restrictions) come from. Data Service: the shared service configured below. Local is experimental: its feed drivers are partial, and a store that depends on its catalog should stay on the Data Service until Local has run in production. Local: this site downloads each distributor's feeds with its own distributor credentials into its own tables, synced by the catalog worker; FFL search and updates still use the connection below when it is filled in. Choose it on a new site, before anything has synced: an existing site cannot switch yet. A store on Local also enables the catalog worker (COMPOSE_PROFILES=catalog in the deploy .env).

fields.label: Connection
fields.description: The shared data service this store reads FFL verification and distributor catalogs from. A Distributor row may override the catalog service for its own house.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: Base URL of the service, without a trailing path.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Issued by the service operator; identifies this store.

fields.label: Category mirror
fields.description: The catalog master's category tree is the one source of category names, parents and order: this store's Item Groups and its website categories follow it. Report only: every tick lists what the mirror would link, create, rename or move, and changes nothing. Apply: it does it, and follows the master's product categories. Off: nothing runs.

fields.label: Could not link
fields.description: Categories the last run could not link (a duplicate, a conflict, a missing parent). Nothing is guessed: fix them in the catalog workbench (a store category slug on the node) or on the store.

fields.label: Product changes baselined
fields.description: Set by the mirror's first run: the product-change follower takes only changes made after it. Items already on file move through the resync (dry run first).
